learning_outcomes.text: Ability to express professional terms in English

syllabus_topics: Questions and auxiliary verbs (Do you know where...? / She asked me where)
Gerunds and infinitives (enjoy doing / stop doing etc.)
Gerunds and infinitives (I want (you) to do etc.)
Gerunds and infinitives (like / would like etc.)
Be/get used to something (I'm used to...)
Verb + preposition + -ing (succeed in –ing / accuse somebody of –ing etc.)
Expressions + -ing, To ...., for..... and so that.... (purpose)
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate decision and indicated in the academic calendar.
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
